title: search index commits on every single post index
description: src/search.rs:49-59. index_post() acquires the writer mutex, deletes the old term, adds the document, and commits — all for a single post. Tantivy commits are expensive (they flush segments to disk). For normal posting this is fine (one post at a time), but during bulk operations (import, scheduled post batch) this could be slow. reindex_all() correctly batches the commit to after all documents are added. Consider a batch_index_posts method or deferring commit to a periodic flush.
